name: motif_start_proposal
description:
Start a Proposal. Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Measure it and revise it before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
Command: new. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Label: The short description a person reads while reviewing the Proposal.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

comment.description: Why this change is right: the evidence, in a few sentences.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_natural_class
description:
Author a natural class. Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

abbreviation.description: Unique environment abbreviation, such as V.

members.description: Phoneme ids in the first set.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_natural_class
description:
Edit a natural class. Adds or removes phonemes from one existing segment natural class after checking its exact current members. The response lists rules, environments and insertions that still use the class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing segment natural class.

expectedMembers.description: Exact current phoneme ids in the class.

members.description: Requested distinct phoneme ids; the class must remain nonempty.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_relink_natural_class
description:
Relink natural-class users. Moves explicitly named environments and rewrite-rule contexts to a replacement class created earlier in the Draft. Other users remain on the source class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-relink-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

source.description: Canonical id of the class users currently reference.

replacement.description: Canonical id of the replacement class.

replacementCreationOperation.description: Operation id returned by the class create earlier in this Draft.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedLeft.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedRight.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

environments.description: Explicit environment users and their exact current typed contexts.

ruleContexts.description: Explicit rewrite-rule context object ids using the source class.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description:
Author a sound rule. Stages one simple rewrite rule in a Draft, using existing phonemes and natural classes with explicit context and rule placement. Empty input or output means insertion or deletion; unsupported alpha variables and metathesis are refused. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-rule. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

direction.description: Rule scan direction or application mode.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id owned by this project's phonological data.

input.description: Zero or one explicit phoneme or natural-class items.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id owned by this project's phonological data.

output.description: Zero or one explicit phoneme or natural-class items.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

boundaryMarker.description: Stored boundary-marker id. Rule contexts preserve its literal identity, even when its code is #.

left.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

boundaryMarker.description: Stored boundary-marker id. Rule contexts preserve its literal identity, even when its code is #.

right.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

after.description: Adjacent existing rule before the insertion gap.

before.description: Adjacent existing rule after the insertion gap.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_affix_slot
description:
Author an affix slot. Stages a named inflectional affix slot owned by an existing category and can assign existing inflectional affixes to it in the same Draft. Inspect its Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-slot. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the new slot.

name.description: Slot name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the slot name.

optional.description: Whether forms may omit this slot.

assignments.description: Optional canonical ids of existing inflectional affix MSAs to assign.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_affix_template
description:
Author an affix template. Stages an active alternative template on an existing category, using ordered prefix and suffix slots that belong to the category or an ancestor. It preserves existing template order and records whether this template requires further derivation. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-affix-template. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the template.

name.description: Template name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the template name.

prefix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of prefix slots.

suffix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of suffix slots.

final.description: Whether the template requires further derivation.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_retire_allomorph
description:
Retire or replace a form. Stages one connected Proposal to retire ordinary prefix or suffix alternates after their references move; the sound-rule form also stages its natural class and rule. Dry Run shows bundle Morph and copied Form text changes, other references, and deletion together. Missing destinations are refused with counts for distinct unresolved Approved analyses, ad hoc rules, and other references; only a person can Apply.
Command: retire-allomorph. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

intent_json.description: Closed motif-retire-allomorph/v1 JSON with exact source, destination and reference identities.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_adhoc_prohibition
description:
Edit an ad hoc prohibition. Stages one explicit Disabled value for a flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition in a Draft. The expected value guards against stale evidence; Motif never Applies this change automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition.

expected_disabled.description: The value the target must currently have.

disabled.description: The explicit Disabled value to write.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_affix_slot
description:
Edit an affix slot. Changes whether an existing inflectional affix slot is optional. The response lists every affix and template using the shared slot; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-affix-slot. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing affix slot.

expected_optional.description: The optionality the project must currently have.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_affix_template
description:
Reorder an affix template. Changes the explicit order of existing prefix or suffix slots in a known affix template. The intent preserves the slot set, and Motif stages a Draft without Applying it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-affix-template. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing affix template.

expected_prefix_slots.description: Current prefix slot ids in project order.

prefix_slots.description: Requested prefix slot ids in explicit order.

expected_suffix_slots.description: Current suffix slot ids in project order.

suffix_slots.description: Requested suffix slot ids in explicit order.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_inflectional_affix
description:
Edit an inflectional affix. Changes which existing category slots an inflectional affix MSA uses. Other MSA kinds and slots outside the category hierarchy are refused; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-inflectional-affix. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing inflectional affix MSA.

expected_slots.description: Current slot ids assigned to the MSA.

slots.description: Requested slot ids; order has no meaning.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_allomorph_condition
description:
Edit an allomorph condition. Changes the environment references on one existing stem or affix allomorph after checking its current list. Shared environments remain unchanged for every other allomorph that uses them. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-allomorph-condition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing stem or affix allomorph.

expected_environments.description: Current environment ids; order matters only for position.

environments.description: Requested environment ids; order matters only for position.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_order_allomorphs
description:
Order alternate forms. Changes the order of existing alternate forms within one entry after checking their current order. The lexeme form cannot be moved, and Motif stages the moves in a Draft for human review. Only a person can Apply.
Command: order-allomorphs. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the owning lexical entry.

expected_alternates.description: Current alternate-form ids in project order.

alternates.description: Requested order of those same alternate forms.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_parsimony_record_types
description:
List Notebook record types. Lists the saved Notebook record types with their portable IDs and readable names. Use the ID when you stage a Parsimony disposition.
Command: parsimony record-types. Agent class: Read.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_dispose_parsimony_finding
description:
Stage a finding disposition. Stages a keep, fix, ask, or defer decision from one finding in a stored Parsimony Report. It derives the exact subject and evidence from that finding and appends the existing Notebook operations to a Draft Proposal. Only a person can Apply.
Command: parsimony dispose. Agent class: Draft.
ReportId: The exact stored Parsimony report identity.
FindingId: The exact finding identity within that report.
Disposition: The advisory disposition to record for the finding.
RecordTypeId: The project's Notebook record type for the advisory record.
DraftName: The mutable Draft receiving the semantic intent.
Reason: The person's reason for the advisory disposition, when supplied.
Question: The question to retain for later review, when supplied.

report_id.description: Id of a stored Parsimony Report from this project.

finding_id.description: Exact finding id returned by that Report.

reason.description: Optional explanation, stored with the readable record.

question.description: Required only when disposition is ask.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_dry_run
description:
Dry Run a Proposal. Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
Command: dry-run. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
Read a Dry Run. Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.
Command: dry-run --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
JobId: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
Timeout: The maximum wait for a result before returning progress.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_finalize_proposal
description:
Finalize a Proposal. Finalizes a Draft as an immutable Proposal revision for a person to review. Evidence for unchanged content on the same Baseline remains current.
Command: finalize. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
ExpectedRevision: The required Draft revision for this write.

expected_revision.description: The revision you last read, to refuse if the draft changed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_parsimony_measures
description:
List Parsimony measures. Lists registered grammar checks, their axes, evidence tiers, citations, and fixed views. It reads the catalog without invoking PanGloss.
Command: parsimony measures. Agent class: Read.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_run_parsimony_measure
description:
Review grammar parsimony. Runs a registered Parsimony measure over the current Baseline or compares a completed Proposal Dry Run against that Baseline. Candidate evidence uses a private copy and stores before and after Reports. Use parsimony measures to list checks and their evidence needs.
Command: parsimony. Agent class: Evaluate.
MeasureId: The registered Parsimony measure to run.
EvidenceScope: The declared source of word evidence for the measure.
AssessmentIds: The exact retained Assessments supplying evidence, when supplied.
Wait for a Parsimony Report. Queues the requested Parsimony measure and waits for its stored Report. It does not capture a Baseline or require an Assessment.
Command: parsimony --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
JobId: The queued job whose result to read.
Timeout: The maximum wait for this call; the job continues after the wait ends.

job.description: Job id from a previous running result; omit to start a new measure.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a result. Default 40.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_parsimony_report
description:
Read a Parsimony Report. Reads a stored Parsimony Report by id. It uses the saved Report and does not run PanGloss.
Command: parsimony show. Agent class: Read.
ReportId: The exact stored Parsimony report identity.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_retirement_review
description:
Read a retirement review. Reads the review state for one staged rule-based allomorph retirement Draft. It returns its latest matching Dry Run and names evidence that is not available yet; it never invents a finding or parser result.
Command: parsimony retirement-review. Agent class: Read.
DraftId: The exact staged Draft Proposal identity.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_parsimony_view
description:
Read a Parsimony view. Reads a bounded page from a fixed view over one frozen bundle. Parser views use a Report id to bind the exact Assessment references; filters and cursors are bound to the bundle. Only the declared view filters are accepted.
Command: parsimony view. Agent class: Read.
Query: The declared named Parsimony view and its filters.

report_id.description: Stored Report id for finding views.

object_id.description: Exact object GUID filter where the view accepts one.

category_id.description: Exact category GUID filter for template-order views.

subject_key.description: Exact finding or judgment subject key.

search.description: Bounded search over returned captions and reasons.

limit.description: Rows in this page. Default 50, maximum 200.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the same bundle, view and filters.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_revise_parsimony_disposition
description:
Revise a disposition. Stages a revision to a saved Parsimony disposition using its exact current Notebook heads and digests. The revision keeps the same finding subject and evidence, and only a person can Apply it.
Command: parsimony revise. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The mutable Draft receiving the semantic intent.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent consumed by the typed composer.

recordId.description: Notebook record id of a current disposition head.

revisionId.description: Portable id of the current revision.

contentDigest.description: Canonical sha256 digest read with the revision.

expectedHeads.description: Every current head with its exact content digest.

reason.description: Replacement reason; omit to preserve the current reason.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_retract_parsimony_disposition
description:
Retract a disposition. Stages a withdrawal of a saved Parsimony disposition using its exact current Notebook heads and digests. The history stays in FieldWorks, and the finding returns to Active after a person Applies the current retraction.
Command: parsimony retract. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The mutable Draft receiving the semantic intent.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent consumed by the typed composer.

recordId.description: Notebook record id of a current disposition head.

revisionId.description: Portable id of the current revision.

contentDigest.description: Canonical sha256 digest read with the revision.

expectedHeads.description: Every current head with its exact content digest.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
